prompt:
Identity-preserving Deep Orbit story illustration edit. FIRST 2 reference image(s) are canonical identities, in order: commander-mirza, ensign-demir. LAST reference is edit target. Keep each character's exact face structure, skin tone, age, eyes, brows, rounded nose, jaw/chin, hair, outfit and side-correct equipment. Demir's comms on anatomical RIGHT ear. Mirza has mature dark-brown face, cropped silver temples and same broad adult features. Keep pleasant curious adventure tone and existing distinct actions.
Keep both characters at exactly their current head/body proportions. Retain Mirza speaking with one open hand, Demir tapping his wrist and looking at her.
Screen content grounded in current Introduction to Tensors lesson:
Replace the tall decorative central holographic stack with one broad, readable translucent panel over the same central holo table. Title "Selected readings". Header columns "Moment", "A", "B", "C", "D". Exactly three data rows: "1 | 2 | 20 | 5 | 8"; "2 | 3 | 18 | 7 | 8"; "3 | 4 | 16 | 6 | 9". This is the recording header and selected sensor values, before creating a tensor. A small separate status line says "ARIA: 4,096 rules, no useful pattern". Keep ARIA as one thin ring with a horizontal waveform on the left screen. Remove every unrelated plotted curve and radar shape from other screens; dim inactive ones.
All labels must use normal spaces. Every number, count and link must be exact and readable. Do not add fake code, meaningless decorative data or invented conclusions. Keep room, camera and furniture unchanged, preserve natural human anatomy. Tone down neon green and bright yellow: use muted sage green display/rim glow, aged brass and natural skin, charcoal uniform. No fluorescent contours. One 1536x1024 image.
cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, slightly stylized proportions, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space beyond the viewports, green #6BAA8A interface glow and rim light, warm brass #A89060 metal trim, cohesive series look, not photorealistic.
alt: Mirza and Demir examine 12 selected readings with the sensor order recorded in the header.
